text:
[LTAC.1.1] An `after` clause is an optional trailing clause on a
rule's RHS. Each clause schedules its action list to run after
the declared duration, measured from the firing of the activation
that produced the schedule.

idris.name: Ltac_1_1__clause
idris.note: AN `after` CLAUSE on the model: its timer kind, its duration, the captures as a function of the parent's match, and its body with every captured read already rewritten to the timer's slot. 'An optional trailing clause on a rule's RHS' that 'schedules its action list to run after the declared duration'. No `as` key and nothing nested: the lowering refuses both. A fixture.
